policy: Human-reviewed unresolved OSM/CUATM cases. Entries document the current evidence and investigation status only. They do not reconcile, reclassify, suppress, or create automatic rules.

cases.finding: Current Moldovan statistical sources refer to comuna Chițcani, including the villages Merenești and Zahorna. The OSM label «Sovetul sătesc Chițcani» therefore cannot be equated to a current CUATM identity solely by name; the relation requires separate review of its geometry, provenance and administrative semantics.
next_evidence_needed: Inspect current OSM relation tags, members and history for relation 6879649.
Compare its geometry/members with the legal/current commune Chițcani identity and component localities.
Determine whether «Sovetul sătesc» represents legacy/de facto terminology, a mapping convention, or a distinct boundary object.

sources.note: BNS 2024 census results explicitly refer to comuna Chițcani and include Merenești and Zahorna.

cases.finding: The relation has no name and no place tag in the imported metadata. A verified Hrușova parent is insufficient to identify the object because multiple distinct subordinate/allotment-type entities may exist under the same locality. No identity is assigned by inference.
next_evidence_needed: Inspect current OSM relation tags, members and history for relation 12104636.
Identify any stable name, operator, ref, cadastral/local identifier or relation history linking the geometry to a documented entity.
Only after positive identity evidence, decide whether it belongs to non-CUATM allotments or another class.
